links.outcome: Gap between users' self-rated AI understanding and enthusiasm for greater AI integration
links.effect: Self-rated understanding averaged near the scale midpoint (3.44 ± 1.22), yet 88.8% welcomed greater AI integration; trust correlated with technical understanding (r = 0.51).
links.quote: Notably, self-rated understanding averaged near the scale midpoint (3.44 ± 1.22), yet 88.8% welcomed greater AI integration.

screen.reason: Multi-institutional survey of radiation oncologists and medical physicists assessing real-world implementation patterns, barriers, trust, and workflow integration of AI (predominantly auto-contouring) without testing a specific intervention or safeguard.
